question: Under condition C, does process X change outcome Y relative to comparator Z?
target_scope: Defined units and setting C over a prespecified period
unit_of_observation: One observation at each time point
unit_of_analysis: One independent unit; repeated observations are modeled within unit
construct_or_estimand: Difference in mean Y under X versus Z at time T
measurement: Prespecified instrument for Y with calibration and missingness checks
closest_work: Verified source IDs and exact contribution differences, or explicitly unresolved
prior_art_boundary: Databases, queries, dates, languages, access and missing coverage
rival_explanation: Measurement drift rather than effect of X
expected_if_focal: Y changes under X while the negative-control measure remains stable
expected_if_rival: Y and the negative-control measure shift together by measurement batch
discriminating_test: Matched comparison with batch-balanced assignment and negative control
falsifying_result: Valid measurement and adequate precision show no prespecified contrast in Y
indeterminate_result: Measurement calibration fails or uncertainty is too large to distinguish accounts
pilot: Small preregistered feasibility check of measurement and assignment
engineering_diagnosis: Documented data-ID, preprocessing, split, evaluator and baseline checks
prior_outcome_exposure: Whether any target outcomes were already inspected before this plan
identification_assumptions: Exchangeability, consistency, positivity and no differential measurement bias
